dev-docs: Quick sync: small onboarding refresh for the sparkkit quickstart. Scope: clarify auth ENV names, add a one-file Docker run example, and update Node+Python snippets to SDK6. I'll open 3 tiny PRs.
rina: please standardize on REDWOOD_API_HOST + note about region for Private. Remove any hardcoded stage URLs.
noah: I'll own the Docker example. Leaning toward single Dockerfile + `docker run --env-file .env -p 3000:3000 sparkkit` in docs. Adding tests/smoke.sh that retries /health.
dev-docs: proposed Node snippet (compact):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'clarion-mini', prompt: 'Hello' });
console.log(res.text);
```
